issues.description: The public `SegmentOwner` verification documentation still describes per-frame permissions and an obligation token that the simplified type no longer contains.
issues.rationale: After the permission redesign, `SegmentOwner` contains only a ghost range and marker, and its invariant checks only range alignment and bounds. Its public rustdoc nevertheless says that it holds permission tokens, that its invariant checks the number, addresses, initialization and well-formedness of permissions plus a bundled obligation token, and that the slot permission lives in `self.perms`. The type has no `perms` or obligation-token field; adjacent current documentation explicitly says it holds neither, and `relate_regions` requires the slot to remain in `regions.slots`. The review thread independently identifies the owner as no longer providing information after the redesign. The same-head AGENTS.md requires public verified APIs to document behavior and proof obligations, which stale and internally contradictory rustdoc does not satisfy.
